title: Change a Ticket Time
wrap_friend: 你剛剛用簡單英文詢問改票時間，聽懂可用時間，並確認新的時間。
scenario: You want to change the time on a transport ticket.
learner_goal: Ask to change the ticket time, choose an available time, and confirm it.
register_notes: Polite everyday counter English. No refund, fare penalty, booking identity, or complaint language.
support_text: Ask to change your ticket time. Listen for the available time and confirm it.

turns.speaker: npc
turns.surface: Hello. How can I help you?
turns.speak: Hello. How can I help you?

friend.hint: Ask politely to change the time on your ticket.

choices.surface: Can I change my ticket time?
choices.speak: Can I change my ticket time?

choices.surface: Can I change my hotel room?
choices.speak: Can I change my hotel room?
choices.feedback: This is hotel language. You need to ask about your ticket time.

choices.surface: Can I bought my ticket time?
choices.translation: 我可以買了我的票時間嗎？
choices.speak: Can I bought my ticket time?
choices.feedback: Use Can I change my ticket time? for a polite request.

turns.speaker: npc
turns.surface: The next available time is four thirty.
turns.speak: The next available time is four thirty.
turns.translation: 下一個可用時間是四點半。

friend.hint: The staff offers four thirty. Accept that time.

inline_explain.title: available time
inline_explain.explain: Available means you can choose that time.

items.surface: The next available time is four thirty.
items.translation: 下一個可用時間是四點半。
items.speak: The next available time is four thirty.

choices.feedback: Four thirty is a clock time. Accept it with Four thirty is fine.
The staff gave a time, not a platform number.

turns.speaker: npc
turns.surface: Okay. Should I change it to four thirty?
turns.speak: Okay. Should I change it to four thirty?
turns.translation: 好的。我要把它改成四點半嗎？

choices.surface: Yes, please change it to four thirty.
choices.speak: Yes, please change it to four thirty.

choices.surface: Yes, please change it to fourteen days.
choices.speak: Yes, please change it to fourteen days.
choices.feedback: The new ticket time is four thirty, not fourteen days.
This is luggage language. Here you need to confirm the ticket time.

turns.speaker: npc
turns.surface: Done. Your ticket is now for four thirty.
turns.speak: Done. Your ticket is now for four thirty.
turns.translation: 好了。你的票現在是四點半。

friend.hint: The change is complete. Acknowledge and close.

choices.surface: Thank you. That works for me.
choices.speak: Thank you. That works for me.

choices.surface: Thank you. I need my money back.
choices.speak: Thank you. I need my money back.
choices.feedback: Refund language is outside this practice. A simple thank you is enough.

choices.surface: Thank you. I am at the wrong cafe.
choices.speak: Thank you. I am at the wrong cafe.
choices.feedback: This changes the situation. Here the ticket time is confirmed.

feedback: Distractors test ticket versus hotel/luggage contexts, time availability, and number-time confusion.
tts_segments: Can I change my ticket time?
Yes, please change it to four thirty.
Thank you. That works for me.
runtime_notes: Fresh EN A2 transport candidate. Structural checks and two AI semantic review passes completed on 2026-06-14 before metadata promotion.

notes.authoring_policy: Fresh-authored in English from the neutral A2 transport brief. KO was used only as schema-shape reference.
notes.a2_boundary: Simple ticket time change with one available alternative; avoids refund rules, fare penalties, identity-sensitive booking details, or complaint handling.
